question: As of November 2022, what is the official language of India's neighbouring country China?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Mandarin.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Mandarin is the official language of China as of November 2022.**
 
• Mandarin is a member of the** Sino-Tibetan language family and is spoken by over a billion people worldwide.**
 
• **Burmese** is the official language of** Myanmar (formerly known as Burma)** and is spoken by the Burmese people.
 
• **Sinhala** is one of the official languages of **Sri Lanka and is spoken by the Sinhalese people.**
 
• ** Bengali** is the official language of **Bangladesh and is also spoken in parts of India.**
